company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that provides AI-powered automated video editing tools designed specifically for content creators. Our tools help YouTubers, Instagram creators, TikTokers, and other video creators produce professional-quality content faster and more efficiently.

policies.refund: No refunds are available after 7 days from the date of purchase. Refund requests within the first 7 days can be submitted to support@autostream.io.
policies.support: 24/7 live support is available exclusively for Pro plan subscribers. Basic plan users have access to email support during business hours (9 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday to Friday).
policies.free_trial: AutoStream offers a 14-day free trial for new users on any plan. No credit card required to start.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period.
policies.data_privacy: All uploaded videos are encrypted and stored securely. We never share your content with third parties.

faq.question: What video formats does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV formats for input. All exports are delivered in MP4 format optimized for social media platforms.

faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

faq.question: Does AutoStream work with YouTube and Instagram?
faq.answer: Absolutely! AutoStream is optimized for all major content platforms including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: How does the AI captions feature work?
faq.answer: Our AI captions feature (available on the Pro plan) automatically transcribes your video audio and generates accurate, styled captions. It supports over 30 languages.
